setup.title: Connect to your organization
setup.subtitle: Enter your organization's Crewhall address. If you don't know it, ask your IT team.

errors.invalid: Enter a valid address, for example work.example.com.
errors.unreachable: The server could not be reached. Check the address and your network connection.
errors.notCrewhall: No Crewhall server was found at this address.
errors.needsSetup: This server has not been set up yet. Finish the setup in a browser first.

offline.title: Server unreachable
offline.body: {name} cannot be reached right now. Check your network connection and try again once you're back online.

outdated.title: Update the app
outdated.body: {name} does not work with this version ({version}). Install the update, then try again.
outdated.manual: The update cannot be installed from here. Download the new version from your organization's Crewhall page: My account › Security › Desktop app.
outdated.store: Microsoft Store updates this version. Update Crewhall in the Store under Library › Get updates, then try again.

notify.updateReadyBody: Version {version} will be installed when you restart.
notify.conflictBody: {count, plural, one {# file changed on both sides; both copies were kept.} other {# files changed on both sides; both copies were kept.}}

settings.title: Settings
settings.changeServerConfirm: Changing the server removes the synced folder pairs; local files are not deleted. Continue?
settings.notificationsHint: Shown for messages, mentions and calls. While the window is in front they appear inside the app.
settings.autostartHint: The app opens in the background, in the tray.
settings.autostartStoreHint: In the Microsoft Store version, Windows turns this on and off: Settings › Apps › Startup.
settings.explorerMenuHint: Adds "Upload to Crewhall" to the right-click menu of files and folders, and Crewhall to the Send to menu.
settings.explorerMenuStoreHint: The Microsoft Store version has no "Upload to Crewhall" in the right-click menu and no Send to entry: Windows does not show File Explorer these entries from apps installed from the Store. Install the app with the installer to get these menus.
settings.shortcutHint: Brings Crewhall to the front from any program. To change it, click the button and press the keys.

shortcutErrors.invalid: That won't work: it needs Ctrl, Alt or a function key (F1-F24).
shortcutErrors.reserved: The system or text editing uses this shortcut. Pick another one.
shortcutErrors.altGr: On Windows Ctrl+Alt is the same as AltGr and blocks characters as you type. Pick another one.
shortcutErrors.inApp: An action inside Crewhall uses this shortcut. Pick another one.
shortcutErrors.taken: Another program uses this shortcut. Your old shortcut still works.
shortcutErrors.held: Another program is using this shortcut right now, so it doesn't work. Close that program or pick another shortcut.

update.disabled: Automatic updates are off in this build.
update.none: The app is up to date.

settings.unsignedNote: This build is distributed without a code signature; Windows may warn on first install.

drive.title: Virtual drive
drive.hint: Your spaces appear in this folder, one folder per space. Files take no room until you open them. Opening a file downloads all of it the first time, which takes a while for large files.
drive.notSynced: Could not be synced. See Settings › Sync.
drive.offConfirm: Turn off the virtual drive? Files on the server stay where they are. The copies on this computer are deleted, except for changes not uploaded yet.

problems.overlap: This folder is inside a synced folder or contains one. Choose another folder for the virtual drive.
problems.notEmpty: This folder is not empty. Choose an empty folder for the virtual drive.
problems.failed: The virtual drive could not be turned on.

sync.intro: The Drive folder you choose is synced both ways with a folder on this computer. If a file changes on both sides, both copies are kept.
sync.chooseLocal: Choose a folder on this computer…
sync.removeConfirm: Remove this pair? The files stay on both sides.
sync.readOnly: You can only view this space; local changes cannot be uploaded.
sync.skipped: {count, plural, one {# item skipped} other {# items skipped}}
sync.onlineOnly: {count, plural, one {# item is} other {# items are}} only in another cloud app (such as OneDrive) and skipped. Download them to this computer first to sync them.
sync.failed: {count, plural, one {# item could not sync} other {# items could not sync}}

errors.local_root_missing: The local folder was not found. If it moved, remove the pair and add it again.
errors.remote_root_missing: The Drive folder was deleted or you no longer have access.
errors.mass_delete: {count} items would be deleted. If you did not mean to delete them, check the folder.
errors.signed_out: You are signed out. Sign in to the app to sync.
errors.overlap: This local folder is inside another pair or contains one.
errors.notDirectory: The chosen path is not a folder.

skipReasons.case_clash: name differs only in letter case
skipReasons.online_only: not on this computer, only in the cloud
skipReasons.outside_space: not synced here, move it into a space folder

screenShare.title: What do you want to share?
screenShare.empty: No screen can be shared. Screen recording permission may be missing.
screenShare.macGrant: To share your screen on macOS, give Crewhall screen recording access: System Settings › Privacy & Security › Screen & System Audio Recording, then turn on Crewhall. If it is not listed, add it from Applications with +. macOS applies the access only after the app restarts.

download.title: Desktop app
download.body: The Windows and macOS app for notifications, the unread count in the tray and syncing Drive folders with your computer.
download.inApp: You are using the desktop app right now.
download.unsignedWin: Windows SmartScreen may warn on the first install: continue with "More info" and "Run anyway".
download.unsignedMac: On macOS, right-click the app and choose Open the first time; the macOS app does not update itself, download new versions here.

admin.none: This server hosts no desktop release.
admin.noneHint: Put the installers into the server's DESKTOP_UPDATES_DIR folder; the apps take their updates from there.

control.requestBody: They can use your mouse and keyboard on the screen you share. Move your own mouse or press Ctrl+Alt+Shift+X to take control back at once.
control.shortcutHint: Move your mouse or press Ctrl+Alt+Shift+X to take it back
control.permissionBody: {name} asked to control your screen. On macOS, give {app} the Accessibility permission for this: System Settings › Privacy & Security › Accessibility. They can ask again once it is allowed.

sendTo.title: Upload to Crewhall
sendTo.signIn: Sign in to Crewhall first to upload.
sendTo.noSpaces: There's no space you can upload files to.
sendTo.partly: Part of the upload didn't finish
sendTo.uploaded: {count, plural, one {# file uploaded.} other {# files uploaded.}}
